quote_zh: The stability of formulations which contain tembotrione either in form A or form C is also markedly higher than the stability of formulations which contain mixtures of different modifications of tembotrione.

the crystal forms A and C according to the invention are easier to handle than the previously known amorphous tembotrione, since during production they are obtained in the form of discrete crystals or crystallites
both the pure form A and also the pure form C display increased stability with regard to conversion into another modification
